cs.t: Custom laptop by DevilTech. I don't recommend them because of bad customer service (it takes long for them to answer to emails etc.), but the hardware has been solid. Bought it 1.5 year ago, so it has an i5, 8GB ram and 128GB SSD along with Nvidia's crappy Optimus technology. I'm pretty satisfied though, as the laptop has a FullHD glare screen and everything I want in a laptop. At work I use EliteBook and iMac.
